header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, CIRCUIT COURT, MIRPURKHAS
Applicant: Zahid Ali Khan son of Madad Ali Khan.
Through Mr. Shankar Lal Meghwar, Advocate.
Respondent: The State through Mr. Neel Parkash, D.P.G.
body: Nisar Ahmed Bhanbhro, J: Through, this Miscellaneous Application, the applicant has called in question the order dated 04.12.2024 (impugned order) passed by the Additional Sessions Judge-I/Ex-Officio Justice of Peace, Mirpurkhas whereby the application under section 22A Cr.P.C filed by the applicant was dismissed.

2. The learned Trial Court, while dismissing the application, observed that the FIA had submitted a report stating that the complaint did not fall within the scope of the FIA Act, 1974, and, therefore, no case was made out. Learned counsel for the applicant when confronted to above legal position, submits that the matter involved banking transactions; therefore fell within domain of FIA Act, 1974. However, from the contents of the application, it transpires that the applicant has a dispute with the private respondents. As such, the matter falls outside the jurisdiction of the FIA to enquire into or investigate the same.
3. Learned D.P.G also supported the impugned order.

4. For the foregoing reasons, no illegality or material irregularity is found in the impugned order warranting interference by this Court. Consequently, the instant Miscellaneous Application, being devoid of merit, is dismissed.
